posts.post:
Friendly reminder that your outfit is a data point. 

Every morning you choose what signal you send to the world. 

If you dress for the algorithm, you look like a JPEG. Flat. Two-dimensional. Disposable. 

If you dress for the room, you look like a human being. 

Most people dress to be seen on a screen. Dress to be respected in person.

How to know if you have a good garment: 

Look at the seams. 

If they are fraying, uneven, or pulling, the designer didn't care about the lifespan of the piece. 

If they didn't care about the build, they definitely didn't care about your silhouette. 

Stop paying for branding. Start paying for engineering.
